bottleneck_type: sync (cross-core / inter-phase dependency chain serialization), NOT compute, NOT transfer
optimization: Form A single_kv_block task batching: kv_iters==1 collapsed eff_num_outer/batch_iters to 1, so the NUM_STAGES=8 pipeline and the io_buf[2] ping-pong never had a second slot in flight and every task ran a strictly serial C-QK -> V-softmax -> C-PV -> V-epi chain. Batching the TASK dimension puts up to 8 tasks in one protocol round (slot i <-> task my_start+kb*NUM_STAGES+i), so V's softmax(t+1) follows softmax(t) instead of waiting for C's PV(t)+V's epi(t), and C's Q/K/V loads of t+1 overlap V's softmax(t).

camodel_mechanism_verification.observation1_C_wait: C FLOWCTRL 7.726 -> 6.564us (-1.162us, -15.0%); V FLOWCTRL 5.876 -> 3.705us (-2.171us, -37.0%); C wall 9.093 -> 7.919us (-12.9%); V wall 9.637 -> 8.487us (-11.9%). HONEST CAVEAT: C's wait RATIO stays high (85.0% -> 82.9%) because C's real work (CUBE 0.322 + MTE1 0.502 + FIXP 2.108us) is intrinsically much smaller than V's VECTOR 3.368us on this shape - C is structurally the lighter core. The defect was that those waits sat ON the critical dependency chain, and that is what was removed (V wait -37%, V VECTOR share 35.1% -> 39.7%).
camodel_mechanism_verification.observation2_mte_vector_serial: RESOLVED: overlap 0.1297 -> 0.5146us (+296.7%) = 5.30% -> 20.93% of MTE busy (x3.95) and 3.83% -> 15.28% of VECTOR busy (x3.99) -> io_buf[2] ping-pong demonstrably activated. Corroboration: V MTE2 union +54.6% while total MTE union only +0.5% (transfers spread out and overlapped, not increased); V MTE3 union -38.8% (the two writebacks now back-to-back inside batched phase-2).
camodel_mechanism_verification.observation3_vector_fragmentation: PARTIALLY RESOLVED: segment count 11 -> 10 and the gap between the two real softmax computations collapsed 2.684 -> 0.582us (-78.3%), with the gap content changing from 'wait for the other core's PV+epi phase' to 'own necessary DMA (P0 write 187.6ns + w1[1] read 350.3ns)'. NOT ACHIEVED (recorded honestly): the micro-fragment COUNT did not materially drop (6 -> 6 under a <60ns threshold, 8 -> 8 under <100ns) - those are the BAR/prologue-epilogue bookkeeping inherent to the flag-managed copy ownership pattern, which batching does not remove; [#R3-4] already proved decisively that cutting such instruction counts does not shrink wall, so it was not targeted.
camodel_mechanism_verification.expected_cost_of_real_overlap: the two softmax segments each grew 1537.8 -> 1553.0/1608.1ns (+1.0%/+4.6%) = UB bandwidth contention between MTE2 and VECTOR; net wall still -12%
